title: Omega Research Pack v4 — Omega Core and History-Bound Life-Key Prototype
description: Research software accompanying the Omega-NR framework. The package implements Omega Core v4 path-history features, a multivariate robust metric, Omega irreversibility and reversal statistics, and the Omega Life-Key v4 history-bound key-evolution research prototype. It includes adversarial simulations, negative controls, real time-series benchmarks, reproducibility tests, and a generic sensor CSV adapter. This is research software and not production cryptography.
